newsitem.title: UK: London tea auction sees hefty hikes for mediums.
newsitem.headline: London tea auction sees hefty hikes for mediums.

text.p: Monday's London tea auction saw medium types raise their value by a hefty five to ten pence per kg in intense trade and bids occasionally moved even higher, the official report said.
Increases of four to eight pence for Bright East African teas reflected strong demand, the report said.
There was keen competition for offshore teas and at significantly higher rates, particularly for coloury types.
The next auction is on Monday, March 17. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 8071
